# SearchPrex

> SearchPrex is a remote-first, US-focused founder-led SEO agency specializing in Law Firm SEO, Ecommerce SEO (Shopify/WooCommerce), and Local SEO across all 50 U.S. states. Founded by certified SEO analyst Mubashar Sharif, the agency focuses on technical SEO, Core Web Vitals optimization, and AI Search Readiness (AEO/GEO).

## Founder Information
- **Founder & CEO:** Mubashar Sharif
- **Credentials:** Certified Senior SEO Analyst, Semrush Certified, HubSpot Verified.
- **Experience:** Specializes in Technical SEO, E-E-A-T, Knowledge Graph Entity Engineering, and Google Indexing Recovery.
